original_question: Is B Γ̄q 2q-connected i.e. do πi (B Γ̄q ) vanish for all i ≤ 2q?
target_in_paper: Section 9.1, Question 9.1 (“Haefliger-Thurston conjecture”): the smooth-category question asking whether B\overline{\Gamma}_q is 2q-connected.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper’s official formulation almost verbatim: it names the correct space B\overline{\Gamma}_q, the correct connectivity threshold 2q, and the equivalent vanishing statement for the homotopy groups π_i(B\overline{\Gamma}_q) for i \le 2q. So it is targeting exactly Question 9.1.
missing_details: The paper explicitly fixes the smooth (C^\infty) Haefliger-structure setting before posing the question.
The question is a family of questions, one for each integer q \ge 0, not just for an unspecified single q.
B\Gamma_q should be identified as Haefliger’s classifying space for codimension-q \Gamma_q-structures.
B\overline{\Gamma}_q should be identified as the fibre of the map B\Gamma_q \to BO(q), equivalently the classifying space for codimension-q Haefliger structures with trivial normal bundle.
To be fully stand-alone, one should say that a \overline{\Gamma}_q-structure is a \Gamma_q-structure whose normal bundle is trivial.
The paper explicitly names this question the “Haefliger-Thurston conjecture.”
refined_question: For each integer q \ge 0, in the smooth C^\infty Haefliger setting, let B\Gamma_q be Haefliger’s classifying space of codimension-q \Gamma_q-structures, and let B\overline{\Gamma}_q denote the fibre of the normal-bundle map B\Gamma_q \to BO(q) (equivalently, the classifying space of codimension-q Haefliger structures with trivial normal bundle). Is B\overline{\Gamma}_q 2q-connected; that is, does \pi_i(B\overline{\Gamma}_q)=0 for every 0 \le i \le 2q?
justification: The draft is already essentially the exact wording of §9.1, Question 9.1, p. 31. The nearby context in §9.1 first fixes the smooth C^\infty category and then defines \Gamma_q-structures, \overline{\Gamma}_q-structures, B\Gamma_q, and the fibration with fibre B\overline{\Gamma}_q on pp. 30–31. Because the paper also discusses lower-regularity and PL analogues nearby, those contextual details are needed to make the question fully stand-alone and paper-faithful. I therefore kept the question as narrow as the paper states it and only supplied the missing ambient regularity, quantifier on q, and the precise meaning of B\overline{\Gamma}_q.
